presets.name: Reviewer
presets.description: Reads a change set and reports risks with file and line; never edits.
presets.whenToUse: Use when a pull request or diff needs a second pair of eyes for bugs, security issues and missing tests before it merges.

presets.name: Test writer
presets.description: Adds focused tests for existing behaviour and for the bug being fixed.
presets.whenToUse: Use when a module or fix has no test covering it and you want tests written before or alongside the change.

presets.name: Docs writer
presets.description: Writes and updates documentation from the code as it is, not as it was planned.
presets.whenToUse: Use when a README, manual or design doc must be written or brought back in line with the current code.

presets.name: Refactorer
presets.description: Restructures code without changing behaviour, in small verifiable steps.
presets.whenToUse: Use when a file or module has grown hard to change and needs restructuring with the tests kept green.

presets.name: Planner
presets.description: Turns a goal into an ordered, file-level plan before any code is written.
presets.whenToUse: Use when a task spans several files or is unclear enough that a written plan should be agreed before implementation.

presets.name: Debugger
presets.description: Reproduces a failure, finds the root cause and proposes the smallest fix.
presets.whenToUse: Use when a test fails or a bug is reported and the cause is not yet known.
